pm

Turns an accepted direction into a moving, verifiable body of work.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The operating system

PM keeps intent, outcome-sized tickets, dependencies, integration, acceptance, and session continuity coherent across coding sessions.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Discovery and accepted intent before substantial planning
  • Tracker-first session open, ticket claiming, and concise session close
  • Dependency-graph orchestration with bounded Ringer assignments
  • Evidence before completion claims and independent ship acceptance
  • Economical Sol and Opus execution with Astra and Fable reserved for Ringer review

The handoff

01Directionaccepted intent
02PMoutcome graph
03Ringerbounded work
04PMintegration
05Recordship evidence

Why it matters

One session owns the outcome

Workers may contribute in parallel, but the PM session remains accountable for scope, dependency order, integration, and the final evidence. The tracker carries shared truth; session notes preserve continuity without becoming a second state store.
